resources.string: Your cameras on the big screen
Open Camnory on the TV and choose Configure with my phone. Both devices must be on the same local network.

Only continue if this code matches your TV. Your Frigate access tokens, ONVIF passwords and Home Assistant token will be shared with that TV. They grant the same access as this phone. Only pair a TV you trust.
Configuration sent. Accept it on the TV to finish. This is an initial copy, not continuous synchronization.
Transfer failed. Check the network and scan a new TV QR code.
Pairing invitation expired. Generate a new QR code.
On the phone: Settings → Connections → Configure a TV. Scan this QR code and compare the verification code. Valid for two minutes.
A private local IPv4 network is required. Connect the TV and phone to the same network.
Frigate servers: %1$d · ONVIF cameras: %2$d · Home Assistant cameras: %3$d
Accept only if the verification code matches your phone. This replaces the TV configuration. The phone stays unchanged. Automatic synchronization is not enabled.
